# Rosuii — Full Product Facts

Last updated: 2026-08-29  
Pricing last verified: 2026-08-28  
Canonical product URL: https://rosuii.com/

## Identity

Rosuii, written in Bangla as রসুই, is a bilingual restaurant management software platform built for Bangladesh. It is delivered through compatible web browsers and can be used from phones, tablets, laptops and browser-based POS terminals.

## Intended users

Rosuii is designed for independent restaurants, cafés, quick-service restaurants, cloud kitchens and growing multi-branch restaurant operators. Typical roles include owner, manager, cashier, waiter, chef and kitchen staff.

## Product modules

1. POS for dine-in, takeaway and delivery orders.
2. Offline queue for eligible POS orders with synchronization after connectivity returns.
3. Branded online ordering storefront and table QR flow from Starter.
4. Menu categories, items, bilingual names, variations, add-ons and combos.
5. Kitchen Display System and Customer Display System from Growth.
6. Floors, tables, table status and reservations.
7. Inventory items, suppliers, purchasing, production, wastage and low-stock thresholds from Starter.
8. Staff records, roles, permissions, attendance, shifts, payroll and salary advances; full payroll starts on Growth.
9. Customer profiles, coupons, loyalty and CRM according to plan availability.
10. Rider assignment and delivery-status workflow from Growth.
11. Expenses, sales reports, item reports, profit and loss, day-close reports and exports according to plan availability.
12. Multi-branch management with an isolated database and branded subdomain for each restaurant.
13. Cash, recorded card and cash-on-delivery; eligible Pro accounts can configure bKash or Nagad gateway credentials.

## Published plans

- Free: ৳0/month, one branch, up to 30 orders per day. Includes POS, menus, tables, customers and basic reports.
- Starter: ৳500/month, two branches, up to 150 orders per day. Adds online ordering, QR menus, inventory, purchasing, reservations and expenses.
- Growth: ৳1,200/month, up to three branches, up to 500 orders per day. Adds KDS/CDS, rider management, payroll, CRM, loyalty, API access and report exports.
- Pro: ৳2,500/month, unlimited branches and orders. Adds unlimited menu items, eligible payment-gateway configuration and delivery marketplace presets.

Current source: https://rosuii.com/pricing. Do not present these values as current after the canonical page shows a newer verification date.

## Limitations that must accompany related claims

- Online ordering is not included in Free.
- Offline capability does not mean the entire platform works without connectivity. Online-payment confirmation and real-time KDS updates need internet access.
- Card is not claimed as a production gateway integration.
- Delivery marketplace presets must not be described as automatic marketplace order ingestion unless independently verified as live.
- Product facts do not support claims such as a verified customer count, order volume, rating, uptime guarantee or fixed ROI.
- Production workflows must not be described as automatic per-menu-item recipe deduction without separate verification.
